title: Serving Runtime — Weekly Update (Kernel optimizations, KV cache, batching)
content:
Weekly update (week of 2026-02-29 — 2026-03-04)

Summary:
- Focus this week: kernel tuning for fused attention, KV-cache reliability fixes, and batching improvements for short-sequence workloads.
- Progressed on low-level Triton kernel optimizations; saw 8-12% throughput improvement on sequence length 512 for Llama-2-13B quantized paths.
- KV cache: fixed eviction bug causing cache misses under heavy concurrent write workloads; added instrumentation for per-request cache hits.
- Batching: implemented adaptive batching threshold (PR linked) and validated reduced p99 latency regressions on sub-200 token requests.

Daily standups / notes:
Mon 2026-03-02
- Kernel: spike on fused QKV + rotary embedding path. Found suboptimal memory layout causing poor load efficiency on A100. Created micro-bench harness.
- KV: started investigating intermittent cache corruption reported by load-test (SRV-1234). Could reproduce locally with stress harness.
- Batching: baseline profiling for small requests (<=128 tokens) — cold-start overhead dominates.

Tue 2026-03-03
- Kernel: implemented layout change + vectorized loads in triton/kernel/qkv_fused.cu. Microbench: +9% throughput (seq=512, bs=8).
- KV: root cause: race on cache index during concurrent evictions. Added CAS guard + unit tests.
- Batching: prototyped adaptive batcher that increases max_batch_size when backend CPU load low.

Wed 2026-03-04
- Kernel: pushed draft PR (GH #567). Need perf regression test on RTX6000 (SRE infra) before merge.
- KV: merged eviction fix to canary. Run with canary traffic (10%) overnight. Observed cache hit rate +4% and reduced duplicate decode work.
- Batching: ran 12-hour perf run; p99 latency decreased 20% for small-chat workload, throughput unchanged.
- Meeting: sync with infra + SRE on rollout plan. Agreed to gradual rollout with circuit breaker.

Open issues / blockers:
- Kernel PR needs validation on non-NV hardware (AMD), and review by release-engineering for ABI changes.
- One intermittent failure in KV unit test under ASAN; likely test harness flakiness — assigned to Samir.
- Adaptive batcher interacts poorly with autoscaler under bursty traffic in a dedicated pool scenario. Need policy tweak.

Performance numbers (canary run vs baseline):
- Llama-2-13B quantized path (seq=512, bs=8): throughput +10% (tokens/sec), p50 latency -6ms, p99 -18ms.
- Small-chat workload (<=128 tokens): p99 latency -20% after adaptive batching.
- KV cache hit rate: baseline 72% -> canary 76% (sampled over 6h window).

Action items:
- Avery: get kernel PR tested on AMD machines (req: run perf harness). ETA 2026-03-06.
- Priya: finish ASAN test stabilization + root-cause intermittent KV unit test. ETA 2026-03-05.
- Diego: tune autoscaler policy to account for adaptive batcher burst behavior; coordinate with infra. ETA 2026-03-09.
- Lin: add dashboards for per-customer KV hit rates and eviction metrics. ETA 2026-03-10.

Meeting notes (2026-03-04 sync with SRE + infra)
- Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> full over 48-72h windows, stop on error rates or latency SLO breach.
- Circuit breaker thresholds: error rate >1% sustained for 5m, or p99 latency increase >30% vs baseline for 5m.
- Observability: need trace-level tagging for fallback events (model variant fallback, cache miss fallback). Lin will add tags.

Misc / knowledge sharing:
- Reference PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/567 (kernel fused QKV changes)
- Design doc for KV eviction policy: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRV/kv-cache-design
- Load-test ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SRV-1234

Notes to self / TODOs:
- validate PR on AMD + older CUDA versions (11.7, 11.8)
- run end-to-end correctness test on private deployment images
- draft short postmortem template for last week's cache incident

Status: in_review — leaving this as a working doc while we finish canary and kernel validation.

-- Avery
